messages:
Sam (sales): Hey infra/eng — Pertino Health wants a performance POC next Thu. Ask: sustained ~400 qps convo gen, ability to absorb 1k qps short bursts, p95/p99 latency targets, and CMEK/HSM questions. Need test plan + ballpark pricing for Hosted vs Dedicated. Can we run?

Alex W: Quick qs — are they using Hosted or Private for the POC? and which model/seq len?

Sam (sales): They'll start with Hosted for speed. Model: open-llama-13b quantized. Typical seq len ~128 tokens. Primary deliverables: latency heatmap, throughput curve, cost delta hosted vs 1U reserved.

Maria P: I can run it. Proposed plan: smoke (5m), ramp to 400 qps over 10m, steady 400 qps (30m), 6 x 1m bursts @1k qps spaced 10m apart, soak 45m, then cooldown. Capture p50/p95/p99, token cost, GPU util, trace IDs. Need region (us-west-2?) and multi-AZ requirement.

Suresh R: Sounds good. Two optimizations to enable for accuracy: prefix/KV caching (chat workloads) and quant profile q4f16 for cost baseline. These change tail behavior; note in report. For loadgen I suggest vegeta or locust. Example vegeta snippet: 

```
echo '{"input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":128}' > payload.json
vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=400 -duration=30m -header="Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD_API_KEY" | vegeta report
```

Alex W: For pricing ballpark: Hosted sustained 400 qps (13B q4f16) ~ $9k/mo for steady usage + burst buffer allowances; Dedicated 1U reserved ~ $6.5k/mo committed (plus support & network). I'll produce a breakdown (tokens, infra, burst buffer). These are rough until we run sampling.

Maria P: Ops/security question — they require customer-managed key (CMEK) and ask about HSM. Any blockers?

Suresh R: Hosted supports CMEK via our KMS integration for POC; full HSM-backed key store is usually Dedicated+add-on and needs procurement (timeline ~3-6w). Also note CMEK adds ~2-5ms per request. We'll include that in latency delta.

Sam (sales): OK — can we schedule Thu 10:00am PT? Customer prefers morning.

Maria P: I have availability. I'll schedule the run, create test targets and post runbook in this thread.

ops-bot: Incident created: POC-Pertino-2012345678 — Run window Thu 10:00-14:00 PT. Monitor: https://console.redwood.ai/pocs/2012345678

Alex W: I'll prepare the cost spreadsheet and quick graphs (latency curve, p95 over time, GPU util). Will also add a fallback 7B model run to demonstrate graceful degradation and cost/latency tradeoff.

Sam (sales): Thanks team. I'll update Pertino and send pre-POC checklist (API key, sample prompts, target region).

Maria P: Posted runbook and targets.txt in #internal-storage. Will ping here 15m before start.

Suresh R: Note: enable continuous batching to match real traffic shape; we'll run with and without batching to show impact.

Alex W: :thumbsup: Good plan — see you Thu.
